end_subsidies.description: Every year G20 governments subsidize the fossil fuel sector to the tune of $440B. The Ending Fossil Fuel Subsidies Lifeline highlights this crucial climate solution.

loss_damage_g7_debt.description: The Climate Clock’s Loss and Damage Lifeline tracks the climate debt (in $US) that wealthy, high-emitting G7 countries owe for the devastating impacts their excessive carbon emissions have caused to others, especially those in "developing" countries. Paying for Loss & Damage is a key climate lifeline, a clear climate solution to help the world meet its necessary climate goals.

solution_labels: Solution: G7 must provide LOSS & DAMAGE FINANCING
